components.role: Final-layer copy head (strongest late OV copy). Its query change, the largest in the model (same-token QK z +12..+24, robust), makes A attend from the reply-start position (triggered by the current-token type, not by the model's own prediction) to the answer-type token in the user's message and copy it into the logits; it dominates the direct effect on the output. What it copies is unchanged; only where it attends changes.

Strongest copy-suppression head (OV -198). More selective in A (+10..+15) for the same answer-type context token, keeping it out of the mid-layer answer representation; weaker in B, which lets the guess into the mid-network.
Copy head sharing its source with suppressor 15.1 (cos 0.91); attends less to the user's answer token in A and more in B, importing the guess into late computation in B.
Copy head on the same answer-type source; imports and echoes it more in B (A -4..-6).
Mid-layer copy head; echoes the context answer token into the answer position more in B (A -8..-11).
Final-layer copy-suppression head with the same source as 17.1; suppresses the matched answer token more in B, less in A.
Copy-suppression head; more matched suppression of the answer-type token in A.
Copy head on the same token type; echoes it more in B.
Writes the shared late answer-contrast direction (31% of its down-projection change vs 7% random): the final readout of the different answer, spread over many units.
Same answer-contrast write (32%); together with MLPs 15 and 11-14 it carries the output-side difference.

prediction.evidence: Full Adam fine-tune; A-B is low-rank. OV copy circuits, induction compositions and the source-specific OV pathway are unchanged, so the difference is in QK. In layers 7/9/15, copy and copy-suppression heads' query changes are anti-correlated on a shared key. Tied-embedding same-token QK traces show A: 17.1 strongly up (z +12..+24), 17.2 down, suppressors 7.1/8.0 up, copy heads 9.0/12.1/15.3/16.2/7.2 down; head type vs change r=-0.36..-0.51 in layers 6-16 (p<=0.012), reversed at layer 17. The re-weighted sources are content tokens sharing an embedding-carried feature (dim 239); the late ones project onto the answer-output subspace (z~+3..+4). 17.1's changed query reads embedding-carried current-token features that no late component writes, so it is a fixed reply-position trigger rather than a prediction-gated confirmation. Net direct logit effect in the robust metrics is dominated by 17.1: A copies the in-context answer token (the user's guess) into its output more than B. Counter-evidence: A's mid-layer suppression of the same token; hence p=0.65.
